evidence: The precursors (Reactant A) used in this study were Ni-bis-2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-heptane-3,5-dionate (Ni(tmhd)2) for NiO and iridium (III) acetylacetonate (Ir(acac)3) for IrO2. These precursors were placed in open glass boats within the reactor, and N2 was used as a carrier and purging gas. Ozone (O3) was used as the oxygen source (Reactant B), which was supplied by the ozone generator near the ALD reactor.
